CREATE TABLE [Groups] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [GroupName] nvarchar(200) NOT NULL,
    [Groupcode] int NOT NULL IDENTITY,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Groups] PRIMARY KEY ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [Permissions] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [PermissionCode] int NOT NULL IDENTITY,
    [PermissionType] int NOT NULL,
    [PermissionSource] int NOT NULL,
    [OrgId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [RecivedId] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [PermissionReason] nvarchar(200) NOT NULL,
    [StartDate] date NOT NULL,
    [EndDate] date NOT NULL,
    [StartTime] time NOT NULL,
    [EndTime] time NOT NULL,
    [IsGroup] bit NOT NULL,
    [Notes] nvarchar(1000) NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Permissions] PRIMARY KEY ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [Attachments] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [FilePath] nvarchar(200) NOT NULL,
    [FileName] nvarchar(100) NOT NULL,
    [PermissionId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Attachments] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Attachments_Permissions_PermissionId] FOREIGN KEY ([PermissionId]) REFERENCES [Permissions] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE [Visitors] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [UserId] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [VisitorName] nvarchar(200) NULL,
    [NationalID] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [PhoneNumber] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [WhatsAppNumber] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [Email] nvarchar(200) NULL,
    [permissionStatus] int NOT NULL,
    [IsFavorite] bit NOT NULL,
    [IsArchived] bit NOT NULL,
    [GroupId] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [Actions] int NULL,
    [PermissionId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Visitors] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Visitors_Groups_GroupId] FOREIGN KEY ([GroupId]) REFERENCES [Groups] ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Visitors_Permissions_PermissionId] FOREIGN KEY ([PermissionId]) REFERENCES [Permissions] ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [Violations] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [Violationtype] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Date] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [Location] nvarchar(200) NULL,
    [Description] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [FileName] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [FilePath] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [VisitorId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Violations] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Violations_Visitors_VisitorId] FOREIGN KEY ([VisitorId]) REFERENCES [Visitors] ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [VisitorPermissionSteps] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [PermissionId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [Description] nvarchar(200) NULL,
    [Reason] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [Date] datetime2 NULL,
    [VisitorId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [StartDate] date NOT NULL,
    [EndDate] date NOT NULL,
    [StartTime] time NOT NULL,
    [EndTime] time NOT NULL,
    [UserId] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [VisitorName] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [NationalID] int NULL,
    [PhoneNumber] int NULL,
    [WhatsAppNumber] int NULL,
    [Email] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [OrgId] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [RecivedId] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [Notes] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [permissionStatus] int NOT NULL,
    [Action] int NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_VisitorPermissionSteps] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_VisitorPermissionSteps_Permissions_PermissionId] FOREIGN KEY ([PermissionId]) REFERENCES [Permissions] ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_VisitorPermissionSteps_Visitors_VisitorId] FOREIGN KEY ([VisitorId]) REFERENCES [Visitors] ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [CancelRequests] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [ReasonForCancled] int NOT NULL,
    [status] int NOT NULL,
    [reason] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [ViolationId] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [VisitorId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_CancelRequests] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_CancelRequests_Violations_ViolationId] FOREIGN KEY ([ViolationId]) REFERENCES [Violations] ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_CancelRequests_Visitors_VisitorId] FOREIGN KEY ([VisitorId]) REFERENCES [Visitors] ([Id])
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX [IX_CancelRequests_ViolationId] ON [CancelRequests] ([ViolationId]) WHERE [ViolationId] IS NOT NULL;

CREATE TABLE [StepsAttachment] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [FilePath] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [FileName] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [VisitorPermissionStepsId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_StepsAttachment] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_StepsAttachment_VisitorPermissionSteps_VisitorPermissionStepsId] FOREIGN KEY ([VisitorPermissionStepsId]) REFERENCES [VisitorPermissionSteps] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE

ALTER TABLE [VisitorPermissionSteps] ADD [CancelRequestId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL DEFAULT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';

ALTER TABLE [VisitorPermissionSteps] ADD [CancelRequestId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL DEFAULT '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';
ALTER TABLE [VisitorPermissionSteps] ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_VisitorPermissionSteps_CancelRequests_CancelRequestId] FOREIGN KEY ([CancelRequestId]) REFERENCES [CancelRequests] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX [IX_VisitorPermissionSteps_CancelRequestId] ON [VisitorPermissionSteps] ([CancelRequestId]) WHERE [CancelRequestId] IS NOT NULL;
ALTER TABLE [VisitorPermissionSteps] ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_VisitorPermissionSteps_CancelRequests_CancelRequestId] FOREIGN KEY ([CancelRequestId]) REFERENCES [CancelRequests] ([Id]);

CREATE TABLE [violationAttachment] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [FilePath] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [FileName] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [ViolationId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_violationAttachment] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_violationAttachment_Violations_ViolationId] FOREIGN KEY ([ViolationId]) REFERENCES [Violations] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE

ALTER TABLE [Visitors] ADD [VisitorCode] int NOT NULL IDENTITY;

CREATE TABLE [LK_PermissionType] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,

ALTER TABLE [Permissions] ADD [IsParking] bit NOT NULL DEFAULT CAST(0 AS bit);

CREATE TABLE [Parking] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CarType] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [CarPlateData] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [CarColor] nvarchar(max) NULL,
    [CarModel] nvarchar(max) NULL,

    [PermissionId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT [PK_Parking] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Parking_Permissions_PermissionId] FOREIGN KEY ([PermissionId]) REFERENCES [Permissions] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
ALTER TABLE [Permissions] ADD [IsReminder] bit NOT NULL DEFAULT CAST(0 AS bit);

CREATE TABLE [CheckIn_OutVisitor] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [DateIn] datetime2 NULL,
    [DateOut] datetime2 NULL,
    [VisitorId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,

    [State] int NOT NULL,
